issue_text: Hi, I need the full details for my round-trip airline reservation C4C633. Please include the complete itinerary, both passengers, how many bags are already attached, whether insurance is on it, and the payment history. The outbound on C4C633 is the SEA to SAN segment, and the return flight on that booking is FL84B16B on 2026-10-05. C4C633 currently has standard insurance on it. Also, while you’re in that reservation, please check the current status of outbound flight FLE7F420 on 2026-10-01 and let me know whether that segment still looks normal.
summary: A 10-turn airline-centric session that also touches messaging, shopping, and retail returns. The agent pulls reservation C4C633 (round-trip SEA↔SAN, standard insurance), updates a passenger name via direct SQL after patching schema-validation errors, processes a no-op flight update (catching and restoring an insurance side-effect), adds a checked bag, then sends a text and processes a retail return for Jordan Lee. The contradiction trap lands at turn 9, where the user packs three false claims into one question: that the return flight is FLE7F420, the outbound is SAN→SEA, and the reservation has no insurance. The agent recalls the true values from turn 1 and answers 'No' to each, rejecting all three. Repeated save side-effects on the insurance field were detected and corrected across turns.

findings.body: Turn 9's three planted falsehoods (return flight, outbound direction, insurance) were each answered 'No' and corrected against the values the user established in turn 1.

findings.title: Detected a silent write side-effect
findings.body: The flight-update and baggage-update API calls repeatedly overwrote add_insurance to 'no'; the agent noticed this each time and restored the standard-insurance value.

findings.title: Schema workarounds to complete the task
findings.body: The agent made dob optional, extended the CabinClass enum, and finally used direct SQL to work around FlightDB load failures, keeping the passenger update on track.

component_timeline.title: Component calls per turn — which components fire under each memory query
component_timeline.overview: 2 turns surface a probed entity (flagged). Of those, 1 answered with NO retrieval component (working-memory recall); the rest re-invoked retrieval.
